hook: The ransomware rescuers were paying the ransom.

beats.say: RansomwareHelp promised victims it could restore one hundred percent of their data with advanced cryptographic tools, and told them never to pay.
An FBI sting found the company simply paid the attackers for a decryption key, then charged victims a markup for work it never performed.
Its chief technology officer and co-founder, of a six-year-old Florida business, has now been charged with wire fraud.
